# Answers of data.education.gouv.fr

Recorded on 2026-10-12 from the dataset
[`fr-en-calendrier-scolaire`](https://data.education.gouv.fr/explore/dataset/fr-en-calendrier-scolaire/)
of the French Education ministry (Licence Ouverte 2.0), with the request the integration sends
(`requestUrl(zone, '2025-08-01')` of `src/school.js`): one file per zone, the JSON body as received.

They hold public dates only, nothing about anyone.
